talkingPoints.text: easy to blend with good color hold

benefits.text:
BBIA Essential Eye Palette is an eyeshadow palette of essential shades that are easy to pair and easy to apply across many everyday makeup styles. The palette combines matte shades, shimmer shades and harmonious transition tones, helping users easily create eye looks from natural and soft to more defined depth. The powder is fine, easy to blend and easy to layer, helping color go on evenly across the eyelid, suitable for both beginners and those already used to eye makeup.
1. Essential, easy-to-pair shades, suited to many makeup looks for school, work and going out.
2. Combines matte and shimmer shades to create depth, highlights and natural color transitions for the eyes.
3. Soft, fine powder texture that is easy to blend and layer to adjust intensity as needed.

With palettes in mauve, peach and hearting tones, BBIA Essential Eye Palette suits those who need a compact eye palette with enough base, transition, accent and light-catching shimmer shades. It can be used to create soft everyday eye makeup, soft pink/nude-toned makeup, or looks with more standout shimmer accents.

howToUse.text: Use your fingertip or a makeup brush to pick up an appropriate amount of powder, apply evenly over the eye area and blend gently to create the desired color effect.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
